WHAT WebFetch downloads a page, strips it to readable text (hand-rolled HTML-to-text, 40k char cap), and asks a separate digest model (session.runInference, using settings.smallModel when set) to answer the caller's prompt about it. http URLs are upgraded to https except for loopback hosts. Redirects are followed manually up to 5 times but only within the same host; a redirect to a different host is returned as a message for the caller to decide. Page text is cached in memory for 15 minutes keyed by final URL. WHY Without the digest step the whole page would land in the main context; without the cross-host rule a redirect could quietly send the agent to an unexpected site; without the cache repeated fetches would cost time and requests. WHERE engine/tools/src/webFetch.ts — webFetchTool (permissionClass 'network'), execute(): URL parse, isLoopback regex, protocol upgrade, getCached(), fetchReadable() (redirect:'manual', MAX_REDIRECTS 5, host comparison returning { kind:'redirect' }), cache.set(finalUrl), ctx.session.runInference({ system, user, maxTokens: 1024 }); htmlToText() (exported), CACHE_TTL_MS, MAX_TEXT_CHARS. runInference lives in engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts. TEST CHECKLIST 1. Stub global fetch to record the URL and return 200 HTML; execute { url:'http://example.com/x', prompt:'q' } with a fake session whose runInference returns 'answer'; assert fetch was called with 'https://example.com/x', the digest prompt contains the page text, and content is 'answer'. 2. Stub fetch: first call returns 301 with location '/y', second returns 200; assert both requests hit host example.com and the second URL is 'https://example.com/y'. 3. Stub fetch to return 302 with location 'https://other.org/z'; assert fetch was called once, content contains 'redirected to a different host: https://other.org/z', isError is undefined and runInference was not called. 4. Call twice with the same URL within the TTL; assert fetch was called once; advance a fake Date.now by 16 minutes and call again; assert fetch was called a second time. 5. execute { url:'http://localhost:3000/a' } keeps http (fetch URL starts with 'http://localhost'); execute { url:'ftp://x' } returns isError 'Unsupported URL scheme'; htmlToText('

a&b

') equals 'a&b'.
